## Mesh revision task (one per agent)

Give the agent subagent its instruction file plus this task, with real file contents substituted:

```
<context_brief>
<context brief>
</context_brief>

<your_previous_output>
<contents of agents/agent_NN.md>
</your_previous_output>

<upstream_peer_outputs>
<peer tag="A##" name="...">
<contents of agents/agent_##.md>
</peer>
(one peer block per upstream agent)
</upstream_peer_outputs>

Mesh revision round. Read your upstream peers. Where their figures or decisions conflict with yours, either adopt theirs or defend yours with evidence. Return your full revised output in the same format, plus a final section:
**Alignment Notes** (each line: [A##] what changed and why, or "no change" with reason)
```

Before overwriting `agents/agent_NN.md`, copy the first pass to `agents/first_pass/agent_NN.md`.
